ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro-level distribution; low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate the left lobe and inner right lobe, while high-intensity (white) pixels are localized in the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory observed from the median notch to the distal tips of both fluke lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced hemi-lateral pigmentation asymmetry where the high-intensity (white) area is localized exclusively on the right lobe surface.
